always_full_scan.description: Whether this prefix bypasses the delta cursor and the modified_after cutoff on every dispatch

blob_connector_alias.description: The logical alias of the connector that reaches the blob destination

blob_prefix.description: The container-relative prefix placed in front of the source path's remainder, mirroring the Dropbox layout so a file is findable from its Dropbox path alone

default_action.description: What happens to a file matching no rule; the only value observed in the live ruleset is `skip`

destination_kind.description: Which class of destination the rule targets; absent means SharePoint

dropbox_prefix.description: The Dropbox path prefix this rule claims; it is simultaneously the literal `list_folder` path, the `startswith()` needle, and the delta-cursor scope key

rules.description: The ordered rule set, one element per routing rule; the shelf's entire payload

scope.description: The functional label a rule belongs to; the write path filters rules by it

sp_connector_alias.description: The logical alias of the connector that reaches the SharePoint destination

sp_folder_prefix.description: The library-relative folder the rule's files land under, before the stripped remainder of the source path is re-appended

sp_library.description: The document library inside that site

sp_site_path.description: The SharePoint site the rule delivers into

strip_prefix.description: Whether the matched `dropbox_prefix` is removed before the destination folder is built

subject_entity_id.description: The entity the ruleset is about: the tenant organisation itself
